'''Finae''', officially the '''Republic of Finae''', and formerly known as [[Esduna Kingdom|Esduna]] until 1640, is a country located in mainland [[eastern Quia]]. It shares land borders with [[Zhanshe]] to the west, [[Onphello]] to the northwest and [[Myla]] south. Its maritime boundaries include the [[Extraien Sea]] and the [[Northern Eanif Ocean|Northern Eanif Ocean.]] Finae has a population of nearly [[List of countries and dependencies by population|31 million people]], covers an area of approximately [[List of countries and dependencies by area|440,878 km2 (170,224 sq mi)]]. The country's capital and largest city is [[Hishara]].

Archaeological evidence indicates that humans have [[inhabited the area]] of present-day Finae for at least 15,000 years. Indigenous ethnic groups include the [[Biorundi]], [[Trenz]], and [[Garlls]] people. The [[Finaean people]] are believed to have originated from the hills of the [[Pyrru region]] since the [[1st century]] and began [[migrating]] into the territory of modern Finae between the 7th and 9th centuries origin of the modern Finaean people. 

During the classical historical period, major kingdoms such as [[Daifurn Kingdom|Daifurn]], [[Ngagan Beal]], and [[Esduna Kingdom|Esduna]] were established. The [[Daifurn Kingdom|Daifurn]] Kingdom is regarded as the [[beginning of Finaean history]], while the [[Esduna Kingdom]], founded in 1182 AFA, became a regional great power, replacing the [[Thimi Empire]]. New Ayuman contact began in 1240 AFA when Iaioan envoys arrived in [[Esduna Kingdom|Esduna]], starting trade with the supercontinent. The [[Esduna Kingdom]] flourished until the arrival of [[Easuhura|Easuhuran]] merchants, when [[Easuhura]] used gunship diplomacy to force [[Esduna Kingdom|Esduna]] to allow trade outposts. These led to the [[destruction of the capital city]] after their kingdom was given to [[Easuhura]] in the [[Treaty of the Globe]]. After the fall of [[Esduna Kingdom|Esduna]], [[Easuhura]] assigned governor [[Takawsun]] to govern the lands of the kingdom and established the [[Easuhuran Colony]], which lasted only 2 years before he was overthrown by [[popular revolt]] against his heavy taxes. [[Uaundi]], the founder of the [[Frase and Atage company]], was assigned Governor, and moved the capital to [[Hishara]] in 1646. After the [[Great Imperial War]], [[Emara]] took control of the colony. Finae led a [[rebellion in 1691]] against the [[Emara|Emaran]] government. And was granted [[independence]] in 1701 after decolonisation.

Following the [[Finaean revolution of 1703]] by the [[Fuzru Wao]] (lit. 'People's Party'), Finae transitioned from a [[parliamentary system]] to a [[one-party people's republic]], and was officially renamed Finae. During the Start of the 10s, the country was under the military dictatorship of [[Mmidaimatan Iaimatan]] and allied with the [[Dahe|Republic of Dahe]]. Finae became a key major ally of the [[Dahe]] and played a major role in countering [[Fascism]] in the [[Cold War]]. Finae also joined the [[East Quia Organisation|East Quia Organisation (EQO)]]. Despite brief periods of liberal democracy in the 1730s and 1750s, Finae alternated between a more liberal democracy and a one-party people's republic.

Since the 1740s, Finae has experienced [[political conflict]] between supporters and opponents of the [[Fuzru Wao]] (in office 1740–1749), leading to the [[1748]] and [[1754 coup d'états]]. Today, Finae operates under the [[1751 Constitution]] and a government following the [[1751 Finaean general election]], as well as political demonstrations demanding democracy and government reform. The current constitutional structure still allows secured political influence to the [[Armed Forces]]. Finae has also faced border tensions from the [[1755-1757 Finae-Onphello border crisis]], extending to the [[1764 Finae-Onphello border crisis]] involving territorial disputes and military clashes.

Currently, Finae is recognised as a [[wikipedia:Developing_country|developing country]] and holds influence in [[Eastern Quia]]. It is a Unitary one-party people's republic with a [[wikipedia:Unicameralism|unicameral legislature]] comprising the elected [[National Assembly]]. Finae is a member of the [[Quian Union]] and a founding member of the [[East Quia Organisation (EQO)]], as well as a regional power. The Finaean Armed Forces are among the largest military forces in Eastern Quia. Finae's economy is the largest in the region and the 36th globally by purchasing power parity, ranking [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|34th by Gross domestic product]]. Finae is classified as a nearly industrialised country, with manufacturing, agriculture, and tourism being the main economic sectors.
